caseStudies.label: PROJECT CASE STUDY

lavenderFinds.title: Lavender Finds — Digital Commerce & Inventory Platform
lavenderFinds.intro: A real-world entrepreneurial project where I connected business operations, e-commerce and software development.
lavenderFinds.challengeTitle: Turning a growing resale activity into a structured operation
lavenderFinds.challenge: Managing products, prices, stock, sales and listings across several channels creates repetitive work and makes information difficult to centralise.
lavenderFinds.solution: I built a database-driven management platform to centralise products, inventory, pricing and sales. The web-development work was completed with AI assistance to complement my initial technical skills.
lavenderFinds.impactTitle: From business activity to a practical digital system
lavenderFinds.impact: The project demonstrates how I use my own business as a practical environment for identifying operational problems, designing a solution and connecting business processes with technology.

portfolio.title: Lavender Professional Platform
portfolio.intro: A multilingual professional portfolio designed to present my business experience, data skills, digital projects and professional journey.
portfolio.challenge: My experience spans entrepreneurship, business operations, data analysis and digital development. The challenge was to bring these areas together without making the portfolio feel like a simple list of skills.
portfolio.solution: I built the platform with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and next-intl. I used AI as a learning and development-assistance tool to complement my initial skills and explore these technologies through a personal project.
portfolio.impact: The portfolio itself is also a development project. It gives recruiters and potential clients a concrete example of how I combine business thinking, data and digital tools.

bicycle.title: Bicycle Parking Data Analysis
bicycle.intro: A data-analysis project using open bicycle-parking data from the Loire-Atlantique area.
bicycle.challengeTitle: Turning open data into useful information
bicycle.challenge: The raw dataset contains many records and attributes. The challenge was to organise the information and make patterns around locations and availability easier to understand.
bicycle.solution: I prepared and explored the dataset, then used Power BI and Excel-oriented analysis techniques to structure the information and create visual views that support exploration and comparison.
bicycle.impact: The project demonstrates my ability to work with open data, structure information and communicate findings through business-oriented visualisation.

developerSurvey.title: Developer & Technology Survey Analysis
developerSurvey.intro: An analytics project exploring developer and technology survey data to identify patterns and communicate insights.
developerSurvey.challenge: Developer surveys contain a wide range of variables, technologies and professional characteristics. The challenge is to identify meaningful patterns without losing the context of the data.
developerSurvey.solution: I explored the dataset using data-analysis techniques and worked with Power BI, SQL and Python concepts to organise, compare and visualise information.
developerSurvey.impact: The project demonstrates my ability to move from a large dataset toward structured questions, analysis and clear visual communication.

caseStudies.aiAssisted: For this personal project, I used AI as a learning and development-assistance tool to complement my initial skills. I do not present React, Next.js or TypeScript as advanced professional skills.
